kb_name: EcoGuard AI Curated Regulatory Knowledge Base
jurisdiction: India - national statutes and rules only
disclaimer: Summaries are paraphrased aids, not legal text. Always confirm against the official text and with your State Pollution Control Board. Amendment status has not been independently checked.
coverage_limitations: State-specific rules, standards and consent categories are NOT included.
Industry-specific effluent and emission standards are NOT included.
Diesel generator emission and noise norms are NOT included.
Solid Waste, Plastic Waste, E-waste and Battery rules (including EPR) are NOT included.
Environmental Clearance (EIA Notification) is NOT included.
Penalty and enforcement provisions are NOT summarised.
Only the provisions listed below are assessed; a clean result does not mean full legal compliance.

entries.title: Consent to Establish - discharge of sewage / trade effluent
entries.instrument: Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974
entries.enforcing_authority: State Pollution Control Board / Pollution Control Committee of the state or UT
entries.summary: Without the previous consent of the State Board, a person may not establish or take steps to establish an industry, operation or process, or a treatment and disposal system, likely to discharge sewage or trade effluent into a stream, well, sewer or on land, nor bring into use a new or altered outlet or begin a new discharge. The Board may grant consent with conditions.
conditions_to_confirm: Confirm that your effluent or sewage discharge falls under Section 25 (the Central Government may exempt categories by notification).
Confirm the consent category and conditions with your State Board.
entries.evidence_description: Consent to Establish (CTE) order from the State Board, with reference number and date.
entries.corrective_action: Locate the Consent to Establish order issued by your State Pollution Control Board. If none exists, contact the Board about regularisation.

entries.title: Consent to Operate - discharge of sewage / trade effluent
entries.instrument: Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974
entries.enforcing_authority: State Pollution Control Board / Pollution Control Committee of the state or UT
entries.summary: The consent requirement of Section 25 applies to operating the process and making discharges as well as to establishment. State Boards issue a Consent to Operate (CTO) under this Section, normally for a limited validity period that must be renewed.
conditions_to_confirm: Confirm that your effluent or sewage discharge falls under Section 25 (the Central Government may exempt categories by notification).
Confirm the consent category and conditions with your State Board.
entries.evidence_description: Current Consent to Operate (CTO) order with reference number and validity dates.
entries.corrective_action: Obtain or renew the Consent to Operate from your State Pollution Control Board and keep a copy on site. Track its expiry date.

entries.title: Consent to Establish - industrial plant in an air pollution control area
entries.instrument: Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1981
entries.enforcing_authority: State Pollution Control Board / Pollution Control Committee of the state or UT
entries.summary: No person may establish or operate an industrial plant in an air pollution control area without the previous consent of the State Board. Consent may be granted with conditions.
conditions_to_confirm: Section 21 applies to industrial plants in an air pollution control area declared by the State Government - confirm whether your premises is in one.
Confirm that your plant is covered (exemptions can be notified for some categories).
entries.evidence_description: Consent to Establish (air) order from the State Board.
entries.corrective_action: Locate the Air Act Consent to Establish order. If unsure of coverage, ask your State Board whether your premises is in an air pollution control area.

entries.title: Consent to Operate - industrial plant in an air pollution control area
entries.instrument: Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1981
entries.enforcing_authority: State Pollution Control Board / Pollution Control Committee of the state or UT
entries.summary: The Section 21 prohibition covers operating an industrial plant in an air pollution control area without the State Board's previous consent. Consent orders carry conditions and a validity period.
conditions_to_confirm: Section 21 applies to industrial plants in an air pollution control area declared by the State Government - confirm whether your premises is in one.
Confirm that your plant is covered (exemptions can be notified for some categories).
entries.evidence_description: Current Consent to Operate (air) order with reference number and validity dates. State Boards often issue a combined Water and Air CTO.
entries.corrective_action: Obtain or renew the Consent to Operate covering air emissions and keep it on site. Track its expiry date.

entries.title: Authorisation for managing hazardous and other wastes
entries.instrument: Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management and Transboundary Movement) Rules, 2016
entries.enforcing_authority: State Pollution Control Board / Pollution Control Committee of the state or UT
entries.summary: Occupiers who generate or handle hazardous and other wastes must obtain authorisation from the State Pollution Control Board (granted in Form 2) and apply for renewal before it expires.
conditions_to_confirm: The Rules apply to wastes specified in their Schedules - confirm that your waste is listed.
Confirm the authorisation category with your State Board.
entries.evidence_description: Hazardous waste authorisation (Form 2) with number and validity.
entries.corrective_action: Obtain or renew the hazardous waste authorisation from your State Pollution Control Board before generating or storing hazardous waste.

entries.title: Record of hazardous waste managed (Form 3)
entries.instrument: Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management and Transboundary Movement) Rules, 2016
entries.enforcing_authority: State Pollution Control Board / Pollution Control Committee of the state or UT
entries.summary: Authorised occupiers must maintain a record of the hazardous and other wastes they manage in Form 3.
conditions_to_confirm: The Rules apply to wastes specified in their Schedules - confirm that your waste is listed.
Confirm the authorisation category with your State Board.
entries.evidence_description: Hazardous waste record register (Form 3) or equivalent waste log.
entries.corrective_action: Start or update a Form 3 hazardous waste record and keep it available for inspection.

entries.title: Annual return to the State Board (Form 4)
entries.instrument: Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management and Transboundary Movement) Rules, 2016
entries.enforcing_authority: State Pollution Control Board / Pollution Control Committee of the state or UT
entries.summary: Authorised occupiers must submit an annual return in Form 4 to the State Pollution Control Board. Authorisation conditions commonly set 30 June after the financial year as the due date; confirm yours.
conditions_to_confirm: The Rules apply to wastes specified in their Schedules - confirm that your waste is listed.
Confirm the authorisation category with your State Board.
entries.evidence_description: Filed annual return (Form 4) for the latest financial year.
entries.corrective_action: File the Form 4 annual return for the latest financial year and keep the acknowledgement.

entries.title: Manifest for transport of hazardous waste (Form 10)
entries.instrument: Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management and Transboundary Movement) Rules, 2016
entries.enforcing_authority: State Pollution Control Board / Pollution Control Committee of the state or UT
entries.summary: Hazardous waste sent off-site must be accompanied by a manifest in Form 10.
conditions_to_confirm: The Rules apply to wastes specified in their Schedules - confirm that your waste is listed.
Confirm the authorisation category with your State Board.
entries.evidence_description: Copies of manifests (Form 10) for hazardous waste sent to authorised facilities.
entries.corrective_action: Use Form 10 manifests for every hazardous waste shipment and retain signed copies.
